about_the_game:
🔧 Build the tank of your dreams — one click at a time!
In Panzer Klicker Mk I, you take on the role of engineer, commander, and clicker-in-chief. Your mission: construct the ultimate armored beast by collecting parts, assembling a crew, and smashing anything that dares to roll into your sights.

🪖 Gameplay:
Earn points by clicking tank. Spend your resources on tank parts (tracks, guns, armor – some marked TOP SECRET!) and recruit your elite crew – from commander to loader and two gunners. Every upgrade boosts your firepower and your clicking efficiency!

🌄 Retro style, modern destruction

  • Classic pixel-art visuals inspired by old-school war sims

  • Simple interface – parts on the left, crew on the right, YOUR TANK in the center

  • Score and rank system – climb to the general!

  • Unlock hidden upgrades and experimental tech!

Will your machine dominate the battlefield or end up a pile of scrap? One click can make the difference...

🛠 Panzer Klicker Mk I – Click & build!

legal_notice:
Perun's Forge collects only the data strictly necessary to keep your progress safe: your Steam ID (encrypted with RSA-2048-OAEP on your device, then immediately hashed with SHA-256 before storage), your public Steam nickname, the numeric platform code you’re playing on (e.g. 0 = Steam), and the JSON-encoded game state containing your 13 upgrade values and 33 clicker counters, plus a small integer flag recording that you’ve accepted this privacy policy.

All data is transmitted over HTTPS/TLS 1.3 to our encrypted database volume in an EU data centre (AES-256 on disk and in backups), and retained for up to 24 months after your last activity, after which both the record and its backups are automatically purged. Local debug logs remain on your device unless you choose to send them to us.

We do not collect IP addresses, advertising IDs, analytics data, or any personal information beyond the items listed above. We never share data outside GDPR-compliant processors or transfer it outside the European Economic Area.

You may access, export, correct, or delete your save at any time by emailing peruns-forge@protonmail.com from the address tied to your Steam account, and we will comply within 30 days.
